lessons_used: Choose path redesign is the only kind of change shown to be helpful, winning 1 test.
Finish new screen changes showed no effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no effect across 2 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, choose path redesign, finish new flow, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests with negative predictions measured positive or near-zero results.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.

candidates.title: Grid Choice Path Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen with a grid layout and visual choice cards so users can easily compare onboarding paths.
candidates.why: Choose path redesigns are proven to work in earlier tests (winning 1 test), and choose_path has a high mean time of 514s indicating hesitation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Existing Pet Account Sync Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign_in screen informing returning users that signing in syncs existing pets so they do not reset account data.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or account reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your existing account to sync your saved pets and restore your desktop progress.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync hint to sign_in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 emails) and minimal config cost.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout
candidates.change: Update the pet selection screen layout to a grid featuring clear visual mascot choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a high mean duration of 1017s, showing users need clearer choices.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend with grid choice cards preserves pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but adoption redesigns historically showed negative lift.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Generation Tips
candidates.change: Add a tip carousel component and progress estimate on the waiting screen while the pet renders on desktop.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s, and support reported pets not appearing on desktop.

components.text: Useful tips while your pet is loaded onto your desktop

guard.reason: Adding tips and time estimate to waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s) and desktop display support issues.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen
candidates.change: Add a new summary screen right after home_intro demonstrating basic desktop controls before concluding onboarding.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with pets after onboarding, and finish completion is only 64.8%.

new_controls_summary.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_summary.body: Learn how to summon, interact with, or minimize your pet on your desktop screen.

components.label: Quick Controls
components.text: Click pet to interact. Right-click pet icon in system tray to hide or change settings.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls summary screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High build cost; finish new screen tests consistently showed near-zero effect.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Overview Flow
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen into a story_scroll layout with animated story cards introducing the pet journey.
candidates.why: Choose path screen redesigns were the only winning changes in past tests; engaging initial visual flow reduces initial bounce.

components.text: Discover your new desktop companion experience

guard.reason: Redesigning story intro screen to story_scroll preserves the story job.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns are the only historically proven successful changes.

candidates.title: Sign In Loading Timeout Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification options and connection troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: Support received 2 emails reporting that the sign-in screen stalls or fails to appear, leading to a 72.9% sign_in conversion.

sign_in.hint: If the sign-in prompt takes longer than expected, verify your internet connection and click retry.

guard.reason: Adding troubleshooting hint and notification setting to sign_in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Fixes reported sign-in stalling issues with modest UI cost.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Sample Quality Hint
candidates.change: Add a standard lighting and formatting hint to the upload_photos screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.hint: For clear pet rendering, upload well-lit photos with a single clear subject.

guard.reason: Adding photo upload guidelines and preview to upload_photos is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint targeting custom pet photo generation failures.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Mascot Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a spotlight stage layout featuring an animated mascot preview.
candidates.why: Finish stage drop-off is 35.2% with a mean duration of 5815s; spotlighting the completed mascot builds motivation to complete.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Welcome your new companion directly onto your desktop workspace.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro screen within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Redesign targets 35.2% drop-off at finish step without adding new screens.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Progress Notification
candidates.change: Add a desktop background completion notification switch and visible progress bar on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, causing users to minimize the app and forget to complete onboarding.

waiting.hint: You will receive a notification as soon as your pet is generated and placed on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicator and notification toggle to waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly tackles app minimization during long 2336s waiting time.

picked: Home Intro Desktop Mascot Welcome Redesign

decisions.title: Home Intro Desktop Mascot Welcome Redesign
